lessons.title: Week 1 Part 1: Recognising Early Body Signals & Triggers
lessons.content: In Week 1 of Anger Management & Calm Leadership, this lesson focuses on recognising early body signals & triggers. Parents and carers practise pausing to notice stress cues, responding with calm and predictable language, maintaining child-safe boundaries, and recording one observable example of how this skill supported their child's safety and emotional wellbeing this week.
